# langsmith_scim_token (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith SCIM provisioning token for enterprise SSO/SCIM integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_scim_token" "example" {
  description = "SCIM provisioning token for Okta"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the SCIM token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SCIM token.
- `last_used_at` (String) The last time the token was used.
- `short_token` (String) A truncated version of the token for display.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The full SCIM token value. Only available at creation time.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
